title: Infinitude of Perfect Numbers
exact_target: Are there infinitely many perfect numbers, including both possible parities?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1497 (NUM-003). CC BY 4.0.

John Cowles and Ruben Gamboa, \emph{Perfect Numbers in ACL2}, EPTCS 192 (2015), 53--59, DOI 10.4204/EPTCS.192.5; arXiv:1509.06081v1, Sections 1--2, the unrestricted infinitude question and $\sigma(n)=2n$ definition.
